behavior_findings: The narrow unchanged-poll, explicit-refresh, rejection retention/retry, recovery and terminal-close rules align with the independently reviewed owned portable preview observations. Broader callback lifecycle, string domain, validation and concurrency requirements are original product requirements; they do not claim native parity. Global milestone gates are outside this review.
provenance_findings: The callback API is researcher-authored original API design. The specification contains no copied implementation source or assets. Review was limited to the two listed textual inputs; no product source, decompilation, historical implementation, private traces or assets were read or exported. This is a bounded review of the supplied contract and its declared origin, not independent forensic proof of all upstream originality.
changes: Explicitly distinguished researcher-authored original callback/lifecycle requirements and string handling from the narrower observed regular-ASCII refresh behavior.
limitations: Context and directory separation are not enforced by a tool/filesystem sandbox.
No clean-room certification, legal provenance certification, native parity, milestone promotion, graph attestation or issue closure is claimed.

export.excluded: Review report and research paths were not exported. Fresh builder receives only the exported specification as project input.
